notes.title: DLC User Interface
notes.content: The user interface had been discarded and redone many times for the upcoming DLC. Realism must strictly not be compromised by overly helpful instructions and manual. Please wait for the release as it is still being developed. This news is intended solely as a heartbeat indicator.

notes.title: Vacant Area
notes.content: The staff room has a vacant area. It will likely be filled with non-essential mini games related to problem solving. Any comments and suggestions are welcome.

notes.title: DLC News
notes.content:
Expect the DLC Advances in Cryptology 2 to release before the DLC Advances in Cryptology 1.

Advances in Cryptology 2 status:
[list]
[*] Stochastic methods - done.
[*] Cryptanalytic methods - done.
[*] User interface - in progress.
[*] Story - in progress.
[*] Manual - in progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Advances in Cryptology 2
notes.content: Advances in Cryptology 2 is coming soon. It is about 3DES cryptanalysis.

notes.title: Early Access to Full Release
notes.content:
Operation Deep Magic: Cryptanalysis left Early Access and entered full release. It will continue to receive content updates. Any content requests can be posted in the Discussion. All essential features for performing the core cryptanalysis is implemented.

The story continues to expand from here.

notes.title: Update #0004 Released
notes.content:
Update #0004 released.

[list]
[*] Natural observation and perception of statistics and algebra. 2 new scenes.
[*] Algebraic presentations of the DES internal mechanism on chalkboards.
[*] Algebraic presentations of DES primitives: expansion permutation, subkey, key schedule, mixing, substitution-box, permutation. 6 new scenes.

notes.title: Update #0003 Released
notes.content:
Update #0003 released.

[list]
[*] [b]3 new challenges[/b] for linear data analysis.
[*] [b]1 new challenge[/b] for differential data collection. Functionality for [i]chosen plaintext attack[/i] launched from the laptop.
[*] [b]1 new challenge[/b] for linear data collection. Functionality for [i]known plaintext attack[/i] launched from the laptop.
[*] [strike]Programming.[/strike] [u]Pseudocode.[/u] Easier to understand pseudocode instead of the C programming language. It is currently in the linear data analysis update above.
[*] [strike]Serial processing.[/strike] [u]Parallel processing.[/u] Functionality with basic display of progress and results for key recovery using parallel processing.
[/list]

Update #00?? coming next. Topics specifically on statistics and algebra.

notes.title: Update #001.2 Released
notes.content:
The entire update #0001 is released. Have added more in-depth analytical challenges. However, the story is still progressive, requiring the player to complete previous scenes in order to move forward. It should be broken up to allow the player to select parts, which is planned to appear in the later updates.

[list]
[*] [b]Seven new challenges[/b] on 5-round, 8-round, 12-round, and 16-round, linear approximate expressions for linear cryptanalysis.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #001.1 Released
notes.content:
Update #001.1 is released. Have added more mathematical challenges on algebra and statistics to allow the player to gain more in-depth understanding of the fine details of cryptanalysis. The second part of the update is [i]coming next[/i] on [i]linear cryptanalysis[/i]. If players are stuck on a problem, please feel free to discuss in the forums.
[list]
[*] [b]12 new challenges[/b] on plaintext-ciphertext [b]data analysis[/b] for differential cryptanalysis.
[/list]
